role: Software Development & Machine Learning Engineer Intern
jd:
Company Description Althais is focused on helping healthcare clinics capture every dollar they earn by turning each patient visit into a paid claim. The company’s AI agents code and submit clean claims against real payer rules, working directly inside the EMR systems that practices already use. By automating complex billing workflows, Althais reduces errors, accelerates reimbursement, and minimizes revenue loss. As part of Antler’s P27 cohort, Althais is building scalable, technology-driven solutions that blend machine learning, healthcare operations, and practical product design.
Role Description This is a full-time, on-site Software Development & Machine Learning Engineer Intern role based in San Francisco, CA. The intern will help design, develop, and test software components that integrate AI agents into existing EMR workflows, with a focus on reliability and performance. Day-to-day responsibilities include building and refining machine learning models, implementing pattern recognition and neural network-based solutions, and collaborating on algorithms that translate clinical documentation into accurate claims. The intern will work with the engineering team to analyze data, improve model accuracy, and assist in deploying production-ready features. The role also involves documenting technical work, participating in code reviews, and contributing to the continuous improvement of the product.
Qualifications

- Strong foundation in Computer Science and Algorithms, with experience in data structures and efficient code design.
- Knowledge of Pattern Recognition and Neural Networks, including model training, evaluation, and optimization.
- Solid understanding of Statistics, probability, and basic data analysis techniques for machine learning.
- Proficiency in at least one modern programming language commonly used in ML (e.g., Python) and familiarity with ML frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow).
- Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or a related field.
- Ability to work collaboratively in an on-site startup environment, with strong problem-solving and communication skills.
- Interest in healthcare technology and exposure to APIs, cloud services, or data pipelines is a plus.

Company Description Cruze is a virtual infrastructure platform focused on optimizing commercial fleet logistics through active traffic control. The company’s technology models traffic as a controllable fluid system, enabling the ability to shape and manage traffic patterns in real time. By developing proprietary hardware-software integrations, Cruze connects commercial trucks directly with surrounding infrastructure. This turns individual vehicles into smart agents that coordinate with the broader network to reduce phantom traffic jams. The result is more efficient transportation, lower fuel consumption, and smarter fleet operations for commercial partners.
Role Description The AI UGC Intern is a full-time, on-site role based in San Antonio, TX. This position focuses on generating, curating, and refining AI-assisted user-generated content to support Cruze’s brand, educational materials, and product communication. Daily tasks include creating short-form and long-form content for digital channels, collaborating with product and engineering teams to translate technical concepts into accessible narratives, and using AI tools to ideate, draft, and iterate on content. The intern will help maintain content libraries, ensure consistency with brand voice, and track engagement metrics to refine content strategies. This role also involves participating in brainstorming sessions, supporting social media and community-building initiatives, and contributing to documentation related to Cruze’s technology and fleet solutions.
Qualifications
 

- Ability to create clear, engaging written content for digital platforms, including short-form posts, articles, and scripts.
- Comfort using AI content tools to ideate, draft, and refine user-generated content, with attention to accuracy and tone.
- Strong research and synthesis skills to understand complex technical topics and present them in accessible language.
- Basic familiarity with transportation, logistics, or technology domains, or interest in learning about traffic systems and fleet operations.
- Organizational skills to manage multiple content projects, meet deadlines, and maintain a structured content archive.
- Collaborative mindset and communication skills for working closely with product, engineering, and marketing teammates.
- Proficiency with common productivity and collaboration tools (e.g., Google Workspace, project management platforms, documentation tools).
- Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in Communications, Marketing, English, Media Studies, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
- Demonstrated interest in AI, content creation, or digital storytelling, such as personal projects, portfolios, or online work samples.
